slides.title: Cold Laval weekend? 5 indoor spots to know.
slides.sub: Space, science, skating and shows, all on the island.

photo.credit: Cosmodôme rocket, Laval · Photo: abdallahh on Flickr, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: The Cosmodôme
slides.body: Canada's only museum devoted entirely to **space exploration**, at 2150 Autoroute des Laurentides.
slides.source: Per Société des musées du Québec, 2026

slides.title: Health science, right next door
slides.body: Opened **January 2023** beside the Cosmodôme. Exhibits and hands-on labs, led by a science guide.

slides.title: Place Bell skates all year

photo.credit: Place Bell, Laval · Photo: MaxCote, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: Downtown Laval's arena offers **public skating** on its community rinks year-round. Check the schedule first.

slides.title: The city's arts centre
slides.body: **Maison des arts de Laval**, open since 1986 at 1395 boul. de la Concorde Ouest.

slides.title: Live shows on boul. de l'Avenir
slides.body: **Salle André-Mathieu** in Laval-des-Rapides hosts theatre, music and comedy at 475 boul. de l'Avenir.
slides.source: Per Tourisme Laval and Ville de Laval, Nov 2026

slides.title: Moving to Laval? Ask me anything.
slides.tagline: Think of me as the friend who happens to know Laval real estate.
